name: Rogers Red Mastercard

apr.notes: Standard rate 21.99% to 25.99% on purchases and fees; 22.99% to 27.99% on cash advances, cash-like transactions and balance transfers.

credit_required.notes: Subject to credit assessment and income verification.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on eligible purchases; 2% with at least one qualifying Rogers, Fido, Shaw or Comwave service.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back redeems at 1.5 times its regular value against eligible Rogers purchases online and at participating Rogers and Fido stores.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none.
